questions.question: Describe the structure of the Balance of Payments.
questions.solution_html:

  • Horizontally it is structured into three main components: the Current Account, Capital
  • Account, and Official settlements or official reserve account (plus errors and omission) It
  • operates on a double -entry bookkeeping system, generally balancing total credit (receipts)
  • with total debit (payments). Current account records transactions in goods, services, and
  • unilateral transfers. Capital Account: Records capital inflows and outflows such as
  • investments, external borrowings and l endings. Official Reserve Account: Changes in the
  • country's foreign exchange reserves, managed by the central bank. Errors and Omissions: A
  • balancing item inserted to ensure the BOP statement equals zero, accounting for statistical
  • discrepancies. Hint: M inimum (2 marks) for defining all 3 components and maximum marks
  • for stating transactions included in each]

questions.question: Briefly explain the causes and impact of public expenditure in India?
questions.solution_html:

  • schemes, education, health, and subsidies. It stimulates economic growth, reduces poverty, and
  • builds human capital. However, excessive spending without adequate revenue leads to deficits.

questions.question: Explain Happiness Index
questions.solution_html:
• Happiness Index : The happiness index, specifically the World Happiness Report, is
  • primarily measured using data from the Gallup World Poll, where individuals rate their current
  • lives on a ladder scale from 0 to 10. The ranking is calculated by averaging these responses
  • over three years, using six key variables to explain these ratings: GDP per capita, social
  • support, healthy life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and freedom from
  • corruption. [Hint: Minimum (2 marks) for stating the concept of happiness index and maximum
  • marks for explaining the variables and for differentiating it from traditional concepts]
